subject: Migration PoC architecture review - scheduling / reschedule
messages:
From: Sam Johnson <sam.johnson@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace Lee <grace.lee@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Migration PoC - architecture review request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Acme infra team is interested in running a short PoC to evaluate migration from our self-hosted stack to Redwood.

We'd like to do an architecture deep-dive with your solutions/infra folks to confirm KV cache strategies, quantization impact, and networking (VPC/Private deployment) considerations. Would next Thursday or Friday (June 11/12) work for a 60–75 minute session?

Attendees on our side: Sam (platform), Grace (infra), and one of our ML engineers (TBD).

If you have a short agenda, please send it over and we'll share any internal constraints.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Johnson
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Johnson <sam.johnson@acme.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Migration PoC - architecture review request

Hi Sam — great to hear. Thursday/Friday both look possible from our side.

Proposed: Thu Jun 11, 10:30–11:45 PT (60–75 min) — we'll cover:
- PoC goals and success criteria
- High-level migration architecture (networking, VPC/on-prem path)
- Serving runtime details (KV cache, batching, quantization tradeoffs)
- Data handling and security controls (KMS, audit logs)
- Next steps / mutual action plan

Attendees from Redwood: me, Dev (infra/runtime), Lauren (solutions), and Rafael (if available) — Rafael may join for the kernel/quantization discussion.

I've attached a short agenda and an initial architecture diagram. If that slot works I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PoC-Agenda.pdf (1 page), architecture-diagram.v1.png (image)
